Body_UpperSideCowl.name: Body_UpperSideCowl

Body_SideFairing.name: Body_SideFairing
Body_SideFairing.notes: Continuous side fairing/blade control surface. Upper right decals triangulate near X 215-231 mm; bottom pan decals near X 100-160 mm. Near engine and fork openings remain under review. r16: flattened inflated interior; observed edge rails unchanged. Local angular blade-tip candidate: three approximate visible tip observations, fixed cameras, two added support rows. No independent validation. r27: forward upper rail rebuilt from three fixed-view correspondence; rear three rows retained. Interior radiator clearance candidate; outer rails unchanged.

Body_NoseCheek.name: Body_NoseCheek

Wall thickness is not metrologically verified. r31 remove blue central underside; black lamp surround remains visible below U-shaped lens.
